background.convention: Native fine-cell depth centres; searchsorted(side=right), depth >= 3.4 km in layer 4; no fitted/demeaned background.

method.coordinates: (saved continuous positions + 0.5) * fine_cell_size_m; weight_indices are NOT locations
method.energy_score: mean_events[sum_j w_j ||h_j-h_true|| - 0.5 sum_jl w_j w_l ||h_j-h_l||], metres
method.hard_energy_score: Mean Euclidean error, NOT location RMS.
method.map: Largest normalized saved weight; first saved atom breaks ties; RMS/median/P95 over full catalog.
method.oracle: Constant-cell arithmetic Vp mean computed analytically; native trilinear uses saved oracle_vp only. No oracle/inverse/forward fitting executed.
method.sphere_mask: Native center-distance <= radius AND abs(truth - known background) > 1e-7 m/s; identical to source comparisons.
method.weighted_rms_spread: sqrt(mean_events(sum_j w_j ||h_j - sum_l w_l h_l||^2)), metres
